Audio Toolkit

Licenses and source

Audio runs on your device using these open-source components.

  • Mediabunny and encoder wrappers. MPL 2.0. Original source. Local modifications.
  • AAC uses FFmpeg n8.0, built from revision 140fd653aed8cad774f991ba083e2d01e86420c7. LGPL 2.1. Complete FFmpeg source. Build hashes. Wrapper and bridge source. Rebuild instructions.
  • LAME MP3 encoder. LGPL license. Source project.
  • FLAC encoder/decoder. libFLAC BSD notice. Audiojs MIT license.
  • Ogg Vorbis decoder. Audiojs MIT license. Vorbis BSD notice. Ogg BSD notice. WASM decoder source and notices.
  • WASM audio decoder wrappers. MIT license.
  • Codec-parser 2.5.0. LGPL 3.0 or later and its GPL 3.0 terms. Complete package source.
  • Preact and Zod. Preact MIT license. Zod MIT license.
  • Emscripten compiler/runtime. MIT and NCSA licenses. Musl notices.
  • Separation components. Audiojs notices. ONNX Runtime MIT. SCNet repository license. Model owner MIT license.
  • Speech cleanup. GTCRN wrapper MIT, GTCRN model and pffft notices, and DeepFilterNet code MIT. DeepFilterNet pretrained-weight redistribution clarification remains open; this candidate is not approved for deployment.

The application and build sources are available in the Audio Toolkit repository.
